news.title: Bangladesh edge closer to historic Test win in Australia
news.summary: Bangladesh moved to within sight of one of the biggest wins in their Test history after Australia stumbled to 161-4 at stumps on day three of the first Test in Darwin, still 67 runs behind.
news.title_tr: Bangladeş, Avustralya'daki tarihi Test zaferine yaklaştı
